name: write_iter
declaration: unsafe fn write_iter (& mut self , dst : usize , iter : impl Iterator < Item = T > , written : & mut usize ,)
documentation:
Writes all values from `iter` to `dst`.

 # Safety

 Assumes no wrapping around happens.
 Assumes capacity is sufficient.
rules: Writing all values from `iter` starting at `dst` must not wrap around the `VecDeque`'s buffer.
The `VecDeque` must have sufficient capacity to write all values from `iter` starting at `dst`.
